title: previewBinding
responsibility: Validates a visual unit preview against its declared screenshot state and viewport.

inputs.name: unit
inputs.description: A unit with its kind and preview binding. Active components require a binding to their own screenshot.

inputs.name: scenarios
inputs.description: The scenario contracts stored at the same revision.

outputs.name: issues
outputs.description: Validation problems for missing component previews or bindings without a required own screenshot state and viewport. Nonvisual units may omit previews.
